observations.scope: whole calls including allocation, initialization, create/join and four equivalent exact-count modes
whole calls including allocation, initialization, create/join and four equivalent exact-count modes

limits: Author histories only; independent learner and reviewer not assessed.
Cache boundary uses selected guest libc reported L1D size, not all cache levels or physical validation.
Common4MiB numeric-buffer budget excludes separately reported stacks, fixed frames, libc metadata/TLS/guards/kernel state and instrumentation.
Whole-call timing includes thread creation and allocation; no steady-state or universal-speedup inference.
Snapshot mutation occurs after capture during the call; simultaneous instruction overlap is not measured.
Explicit known local worker failure is not arbitrary process-death or external-effect exactly-once recovery.
